integrity: The corrected published equation is used. The group upper bound is proved intrinsically from the three tangency points on the distinguished inner conic; exact coordinate checks are independently replayable from the included script.
scientific_limitations: Only the corrected CL7 projective-equivalence class over C is treated; automorphisms of other arrangements or non-extendable complement automorphisms are outside scope. Literature noncoverage is supported by targeted searches but cannot eliminate obscure differently indexed sources.
title: Projective stabilizer of the unique free two-conic three-line arrangement
